'''Masic''' is a man living in the [[Rahad]] in [[Ebou Dar]] in [[Altara]]. 

==History==
[[Elayne]] and [[Birgitte]] see Masic and Baris fighting in duel; the first is taller and heavier than Baris. Masic is bleeding down the side of his face. The fight ends with Masic lying face down in the street. 

[[Asra]], a [[Kin]]swoman and [[Wise Woman]], appears, stuffs some herbs into Masic's mouth and then tries to Heal him; Masic gasps, shudders, and then lies still; the force of the Healing was too much and ended up killing him. Asra tells Baris that he will have to tell Masic's wife that he has killed her husband.
